defect: The 65,535 text limit is enforced with len(o.Text) (bytes) although the requirement is a character cap, so multibyte text under the cap is rejected.
The two newly introduced AppError ids (response_type.app_error, text.app_error) have no entries in server/i18n/en.json — make i18n-extract was not run.
Text-length validation is performed in CommandResponse.IsValid even though the same constraint is already enforced later during post creation, so the check belongs elsewhere.
CommandResponseFromJSON turns a validation failure into a hard error, which can break existing servers; it should log a warning like the caller of MessageAttachment.IsValid does.
IconURL/GotoLocation validation uses url.ParseRequestURI, which accepts path-only values such as /foo, so non-URLs pass validation.
The validation warning is emitted through the global logger inside the model helper instead of the request-scoped logger at the two call sites (commandWebhook, DoCommandRequest).
